capabilities: Render footnotes and [!sidenote]/[!marginnote] callouts as margin sidenotes in Reading view
Compose column, full-width, and margin figures with captions from dropped or pasted images
Convert inline shorthands into small caps, italic run-ins, and CJK drop caps in Reading view and Live Preview
Render linked and unlinked mention snippets as formatted Markdown in the backlinks view
Toggle each of the four modules independently in settings
extras: Modules stay dormant unless the Tufte theme is active. On first load it imports settings from the four standalone plugins; those must be disabled before enabling the Suite to avoid double rendering. Requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or newer; desktop and mobile; no network access.
intentEvidence: This replaces the four separate plugins (Tufte Sidenotes, Tufte Figures, Tufte Inline, Tufte Backlinks).
problem: Obsidian renders footnotes, images, and backlinks in a single standard style and has no support for margin sidenotes, captioned figure layouts, or Tufte-style inline typography.

relations.evidence: The plugin renders the structure; the Tufte theme supplies the typography.

relations.plugin: Tufte Sidenotes, Tufte Figures, Tufte Inline, Tufte Backlinks

relations.evidence: adapted from Tufte CSS and Edward Tufte's book design

summary: Bundled companion to the Tufte theme that renders sidenotes, margin figures, inline typography, and styled backlinks as four toggleable modules.
